name: mailrith-agent-platform
description: Public contracts, SDKs, MCP server, CLI, and Agent Skill for the Mailrith AI agent platform.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @mailrith/public-api build && pnpm --filter @mailrith/sdk build && pnpm --filter @mailrith/mcp-server build && pnpm --filter @mailrith/cli build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @mailrith/public-api typecheck && pnpm --filter @mailrith/sdk typecheck && pnpm --filter @mailrith/mcp-server typecheck && pnpm --filter @mailrith/cli typecheck
scripts.test:python: cd packages/python-sdk && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_*.py'
scripts.validate: pnpm generate:agent-artifacts && git diff --exit-code -- packages/sdk/src/generated.ts packages/python-sdk/mailrith_sdk/contract.json packages/python-sdk/mailrith_sdk/manifest.json packages/mcp-server/src/generated-tool-manifest.ts && pnpm agent:release:verify && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm test:python && pnpm build
